servo.regulator_screen_basis: Conservative 14A reading allowance below approximately 15A manufacturer room-temperature still-air curve at 6.6-8.4V; not a guaranteed enclosure rating.
servo.regulator_iq_basis: Conservative 10mA budget allowance; vendor typical no-load current is below 0.3mA away from dropout. Efficiency floor retained at 80%.

wiring.topology: 8 fused feeds, 15 individually powered servo tails, DATA-only daisychain

scenarios.name: relaxed_idle
scenarios.basis: servo standby official; complete logic current assumed
scenarios.description_en: Powered but torque disabled; camera off and amplifier muted

scenarios.name: standing
scenarios.basis: engineering assumed load; holding current depends on posture
scenarios.description_en: Standing hold, camera enabled and amplifier muted

scenarios.name: walking_light
scenarios.basis: engineering assumed rail currents, not torque proxy
scenarios.description_en: Light walking, compressed single-camera Wi-Fi streaming and intermittent audio

scenarios.name: walking_design
scenarios.basis: engineering assumed rail currents, not measured
scenarios.description_en: Design walking load with jaw, camera/Wi-Fi and 1W audio allowance

scenarios.name: walking_heavy
scenarios.basis: stress boundary; not a guaranteed usable continuous mode
scenarios.description_en: Heavier walking and jaw motion, 2.5A logic-rail stress load

scenarios.name: startup_transient
scenarios.description_en: Short startup load point caused by position error

scenarios.name: all15_stalled
scenarios.basis: 15 times manufacturer stall current at 5V; must stop, not sustain
scenarios.description_en: Specification arithmetic for all 15 blocked servos; stop condition

decision_use: Unmeasured sensitivity scenarios; do not treat walking_design or startup_peak as measured minimum requirements or as purchase authorization.
